premise: One tactile telephone line carries a client signal into Velira's system.
primary_action: One pulse follows one unbranched cable and activates three ordered stages.
final_state: Phone and stages stable; terminal teal; cable settled; blank square logo-safe plate front-parallel, axis-aligned, unobstructed, and motionless.

flow_ui_projection.creditGate: Recheck the signed-in Flow cost and obtain explicit approval immediately before Generate.

references.inherit: exact phone geometry, seated handset, transparent dial, red enamel, black trim, feet, and its single photographed coiled red cord
references.exclude: crop, background, framing, duplicate reflections, any second cable, or any new free end

post_production.method: Composite the owner-supplied JPEG as one rigid, uniformly scaled plate in Remotion; never ask Omni to synthesize, redraw, animate, or typeset the logo.
post_production.typography: Composite all Ukrainian copy in Remotion with the vendored Onest font.
post_production.proof: The delivered Remotion master uses the exact source JPEG with no internal alteration.

props.description: One glossy red rotary telephone matching PhoneIdentity; one seated handset and one dial.
One opaque signal-red cable continuing from the photographed cord into the system; no branch or duplicate.
Three unlabelled editorial objects: browser, conversation, status.
One blank square cream plate, front-parallel and axis-aligned, for the post-production logo.

world: Warm #F4E8C5 paper studio with #303647 navy, sparse #C80D0A red, #668C8F teal, and no people.
global_look: Tactile editorial motion, 50 mm perspective, crisp grid, paper fibre, coherent enamel highlights and shadows, precise mechanical easing.
continuity: Exact counts: one pulse and the declared props.
Cable continuous and unbranched from phone to terminal.
Stages activate only on pulse contact and stay active.
One high-left key light; coherent reflections and shadows.
Logo-safe plate remains square, front-parallel, blank, and motionless after 7.8s for the post-production logo.
physics: Handset moves millimetres with mass and settling.
Pulse stays on the cable and transfers energy on contact.
Cable has gentle tension and no overshoot.

shots.action: One ring nudges the handset; one pulse extends the cable

shots.end_state: Phone still; handset seated; one pulse on one cable

exclusions: No people, hands, mascots, extra props, generated text, or captions.
No second cable-like shadow, ghost, branch, gap, duplicate, transparency, or colour change; one soft attached contact shadow is allowed.
No object duplication, morphing, camera jumps, spins, or scene changes.
No gradients, glass, neon, particles, flares, HUD noise, floating cards, icons, or metrics.
Do not generate any logo, symbol, wordmark, lettering, pseudo-text, or marks on the blank logo-safe plate; reject a deformed plate rather than warping the owner logo to fit it.
assumptions: The requested Gemini surface is Google Flow standard because the user named Gemini Omni Flash without choosing API execution.
Landscape 16:9 and ten seconds are selected to match a premium website/portfolio motion graphic and the current Flow duration choices.
Critical Ukrainian typography and the exact logo are composited in deterministic Remotion post-production rather than generated by Omni.
No paid Flow generation or upscale is authorized in this task; the package stops at the manual credit gate.
safety_notes: No people, minors, recognizable persons, dangerous actions, restricted content, or sensitive uploads are involved.
Recheck current Flow availability, displayed credits, and output settings immediately before any future billed generation.
